about: Youth allowlist for hi_scraper.py. Hawaii's special treatment facility (STF) and therapeutic living program (TLP) licences cover adult and youth programs alike, so only facilities listed here with scope "in" are scraped and posted. "unsure" waits for the owner's decision and is not scraped. Keyed by the report page's row id (data-row_id); a facility on the page that is not listed here is reported at the end of each run and not scraped. licence is the number on the State Licensing Section rosters (April 2026); empty when the facility is not on them.
